summary: Frontend-only route matrix + branding audit completed on public preview with QA1 login. Executed 108 route+viewport checks across 320x568, 844x390, 768x1024, plus new BoundedSheet interactions at 320x350/844x390. Branding testIDs and Mello name passed on welcome/auth/profile settings. One route is invalid (/learn/goal -> Unmatched Route), tutor booking remains untestable due missing tutor data, and one transient public 502 availability event occurred during rerun.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct route /learn/goal renders Unmatched Route (Page could not be found).

integration_issues.issue: No tutor dataset available in tested account/session (screen shows 'No tutors match.'), so booking path could not be validated with real data.
Observed transient Cloudflare 502 host error during targeted rerun; subsequent run recovered and checks continued.

issues: Asset dimensions are correct (1080x1080), but sampled non-background pixels are present outside Android 66/108 safe-circle boundary (likely corner clipping risk under circular mask).

action_items: If /learn/goal is expected by product routing, add/restore route or update links to /learn/set-goal.
Provide QA-safe tutor/course fixture data to validate tutor booking path end-to-end.
Review adaptive icon safe-zone composition against Android circular mask requirement (66/108 central safe-circle).
Investigate recurring Expo log warning for missing '/app/frontend/sounds' asset path (pre-existing noise).

Route /learn/goal is not defined in Expo Router tree and currently resolves to Unmatched Route; this should not be exposed as a navigable path.
Supervisor Expo logs still show repeated ENOENT scandir '/app/frontend/sounds' warnings, indicating stale asset references at runtime.
